On Day 1, each module is 95 minutes: 45 minutes of lecture, then 50 of lab. On Days 2 to 5, each module is 120 minutes: 55 minutes of lecture, 55 of lab, then a 10-minute debrief. On those days the second module breaks for lunch between its lecture and its lab. The capstone (Module 15) fills two module slots on Day 5.
